text: Maya studies biology. She visits the library on Monday and Thursday. Leo studies history. He does not visit the library on Thursday. He usually reads at home on that day.
The library tour starts at nine thirty. Sorry, that is not correct. It starts at ten thirty on Tuesday. The tour lasts thirty minutes. It ends at eleven. Students do not pay for this tour.
I want to book a study room for Thursday. Wait, I have a class on Thursday. Please book the room for Friday instead. My name is Leo. L. E. O. I need the room at two in the afternoon.
